presets.name: Bare
presets.description: The details component appears on one avatar in ten. Off, every avatar in a set is built from the same seven parts, which reads more evenly down a list.

presets.name: Sepia
presets.summary: One warm ramp, skin and hair.
presets.description: The style prints a pink lip on twenty-four of its thirty-eight mouths, plus a few colored eyes, and no option reaches any of them. This keeps the fourteen mouths and twenty-eight eyes that are drawn in line alone.

presets.name: Greyscale
presets.summary: No hue on skin or hair.
presets.description: Useful for a print stylesheet, a disabled state, or anywhere color would carry meaning it should not. The ears and the linework carry the drawing once the color is gone. Same exclusions as Sepia.

presets.name: Duotone
presets.summary: Pale blue face, deep blue hair.
presets.description: Two steps of one hue for a whole set, so only the haircut, the ears and the expression separate two avatars.

presets.name: Muted
presets.description: The style ships pink, red and bleached white among its hair colors. These are tones that hold still, for a page where many avatars appear together.

presets.name: Electric
presets.summary: Hair past anything the style ships.
presets.description: The same group the other way. The style draws hair as a large flat mass, which makes it the right place to put the one loud color.

presets.name: Pastel Wall
presets.summary: A soft ground behind the head.
presets.description: The style ships no background at all, so an avatar sits on whatever is behind it. Six pale colors give it a tile of its own.

presets.name: Bold Pop
presets.summary: Six saturated grounds behind the ears.
presets.description: The heads are pale and the hair is dark, so the drawing keeps its edge on a saturated ground.

presets.name: Night Shift
presets.description: For dark interfaces. The skin palette is light enough on its own that nothing else has to move.

presets.name: Sunrise
presets.summary: A warm gradient behind the ears.
presets.description: Shows the gradient background options: two colors, a linear fill and a fixed angle. Both stops stay light so the dark hair keeps its contrast.

presets.name: Full Cast
presets.description: The details component turned all the way up. The style ships six of them that nine seeds in ten never reach.

presets.name: Close Up
presets.summary: The head scaled up in the frame.
presets.description: The style leaves a wide margin, which costs size at 24 or 32 pixels. This stops short of the tallest hairstyles, so nothing spiky gets cut.
